title: What If You Slept Only 4 Hours a Night for Two Weeks?
subject: tired person

scenes.text: What if you slept four hours a night for two weeks? You wouldn't notice.
In a famous sleep lab study, volunteers spent only four or six hours in bed for fourteen nights.
Their attention and reaction scores fell, a little more every single day.
The four-hour group got worse than the six-hour group, and both kept sliding.
After the two weeks, six hours a night or less matched up to two nights without any sleep at all.
And the volunteers rated themselves as only slightly sleepy. They were losing ground and barely felt it.

description:
What if you slept only four hours a night for two weeks?
A sleep lab study found restricted sleep piles up into deficits matching up to two nights without sleep, while people felt only a little sleepy.
